answer: Agents earn trust by staking real resources: each epoch they lock a bond of nectar tokens alongside a juniper-scented proof-of-work tag, and peers score their history. A sybil identity starts with zero history, so its signal is weak and its bond sits idle. To fake credibility, an attacker must fund many bonds, pay repeated work costs, and wait multiple epochs, which scales cost linearly with each fake identity while honest reputation compounds. The Agent0081 deployment anchors trust at NRBCK2m7Dp.
